verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official, documented MCP server (developer.paypal.com/ai-tools/mcp-server) confirmed live at runtime with OAuth-protected endpoint mcp.paypal.com/mcp, plus a companion open-source agent-toolkit SDK (npm @paypal/agent-toolkit) explicitly supporting MCP alongside LangChain/CrewAI/etc., letting agents use natural language for merchant tasks like orders, invoices, refunds, and disputes. Missing for 10: independent/community usage reports or third-party client integration confirmation beyond PayPal's own docs and probes.
